```plato

    // A vector normalized, or zero where there is nothing to normalize: an
    // isolated vertex touches no face and therefore has no normal.
    NormalizedOrZero(v: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => v.Magnitude <= 0.0 ? Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0) : v.Normalize;
```
